prose: Nikkei reports Fujifilm will raise magnetic tape production capacity fivefold to meet AI-driven storage demand - its largest investment in the medium in roughly 20 years. Magnetic tape remains the offline backup standard for data center operators, financial institutions and research organizations, and the AI boom's data appetite is reviving it.
highlights: AI-driven storage demand revives the offline backup medium
Tape remains standard for data center, finance and research backup
